About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto
description:
Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto

Join to apply for the Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto role at Netvagas

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia, este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco! Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento formado por um time de pessoas incríveis, com ideias inovadoras, possuímos um ambiente descontraído e muito espírito colaborativo. Promovemos em nosso dia-a‑dia um ambiente de desenvolvimento, onde os Atlantes são o nosso maior foco, por isso um dos nossos valores mais fortes é a Valorização de Pessoas. Não é à toa, que estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking do GPTW.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções eficientes para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações novos ou existentes.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas complementares que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando‑se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando‑se regularmente com os gerentes do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos‑chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e à nível de produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados, especificamente soluções de dados baseadas em nuvem, incluindo a capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencialmente) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência no design, construção e otimização de pipelines e plataformas de dados em larga escala utilizando:
  • Frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos, por exemplo: Apache Spark, Apache Flink ou tecnologias similares baseadas em MapReduce.
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data, por exemplo: HDFS, YARN ou equivalentes em nuvem como S3, EMR.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho, por exemplo: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect.
  • Formatos de tabela de data lake modernos, por exemplo: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi.
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes, por exemplo: Trino/Presto.
  • Experiência na criação de soluções para adquirir e persistir novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem, como AWS ou GCP, para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.

Idioma

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.

Desejável

  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e outras tecnologias que permitem uma comunicação de rede segura e eficiente.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real, como Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de competências essenciais de gerenciamento de dados, incluindo governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, OWB/ODI, SSIS, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de design comuns no desenvolvimento de software (MVC, MVVM, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias como Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento prático de sistemas de controle de versão de software (Git preferencialmente).

Vem ser Atlante!!!

Vem ser Atlante!!!

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. Nossa missão é promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, buscando a equidade de oportunidades e o respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico‑racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo‑sexual e de pessoas com deficiência, voltado para a defesa e valorização dos direitos humanos. Atualmente, o Atlântico possui uma subárea dedicada à diversidade e inclusão, inserida na área de Pessoas & Cultura. Essa subárea trabalha em colaboração com o Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão e com os grupos de afinidades, que são compostos por pessoas voluntárias e têm como propósito oferecer um espaço seguro para a troca de vivências, a representatividade e a construção de ações afirmativas.

Impacto Social

O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão do Atlântico investe em ações de voluntariado com foco no impacto social positivo por meio do Grupo de Afinidade de Justiça Social. Nós nos concentramos em apoiar organizações do terceiro setor e projetos de impacto social que trabalhem com os públicos que são contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos nosso primeiro projeto voltado para a capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social. O projeto‑piloto foi realizado na Comunidade de Ancuri, em parceria com a organização Visão Mundial e a ONG Associação Santos Dias, e formou 40 jovens em Lógica de Programação Básica.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI / UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision : bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI / UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to :

Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.

Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.

Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.

Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine.

Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.

Build and maintain UI / UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.

Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.

Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Battle-tested designer : You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).

AI-forward mindset : You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.

Builder’s DNA : Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.

Technical & design skills :

  • UI / UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus : Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)

Startup mentality : Hands‑on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.

Industry experience : Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open‑source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

Early‑stage, high‑growth startup with real traction.

Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.

Opportunity to shape AI‑native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.

Competitive salary + equity

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

O objetivo do programa é capacitar mulheres e pessoas com deficiência interessadas em ingressar no ambiente industrial da empresa . Essa é uma porta de entrada para a companhia e visa habilitar novos profissionais para atuar na indústria, não sendo exigida experiência prévia .

  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.

  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).

  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.

  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

  • Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification.

Important information for candidates

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

Direct message the job poster from Chrysos Corporation

Here at Chrysos we combine science and software to create technology solutions that are changing the global mining industry; both from a productivity and environmental impact perspective.

Just like atoms and machines, we believe that everyone is different and how individuals come together is what makes us successful. Headquartered in Adelaide and with team members based in Australia, Europe, Africa, North and South America, Chrysos Corporation’s diverse team of scientists, engineers and industry specialists are coming together to build technologies to provide rapid, accurate and safe ore analysis for the global mining industry.

The company’s flagship technology, PhotonAssay™, steps around centuries-old chemistry-based assay methods to deliver true ‘atom-counting’ analysis for the measurement of gold and other high-value metals. With successful global installations, Chrysos is taking PhotonAssay™ to customers around the world – Chrysos could take you to places that you might not have even imagined yet. There’s opportunity around every corner and the support to help you achieve your goals.

About The Role

The Maintenance Specialist, with support from the rest of the team, will be providing firsthand technical support service to ensure the smooth running of Chrysos PhotonAssay™ equipment.

This permanent full-time role supporting the Suriname site.

(We are open to FIFO)

  • Maintenance and service of PhotonAssay™ installations in Americas region.
  • Scheduled monthly maintenance as well as responding to breakdowns on short notice to minimise downtime and maximise availability.
  • Technical support service for the installations via telephone, email, and remote computer login for troubleshooting and performance checks during and out of office hours as agreed. This will involve liaising with support staff at Chrysos’ headquarters and our technology partner in China.
  • Training of the customer on the safe operation and maintenance of the equipment.
  • Spares inventory management for each installation site.
  • Complete maintenance and spares documentation and providing feedback to customers.
  • Assisting in the development and continual improvement of the processes associated with the maintenance and service of PhotonAssay™ systems.
  • Assisting in the installation and commissioning of new installations.
  • Preparing fault records for statistics and reporting.
  • Assisting with Root Cause Analysis of faults (to improve reliability) and safety (to prevent incidents that could lead to injury or damage).
  • Assisting in the training of new Maintenance Specialists.
  • Scheduling maintenance events for site.
  • Performing other on-site duties delegated by Maintenance Manage.
  • Supporting the development of a strong WHS culture.
  • Safety first mindset always.

Who you are:

  • Demonstrated experience in maintaining technical equipment.
  • Strong customer service ethos and critical thinking skills.
  • Customer Service and Field Service experience in the mining or mineral sector (or related) processing industries.
  • Able and willing to travel and work within Americas region and overseas, including at remote locations such as mine sites.
  • Proven ability with proficient written and verbal communication skills.
  • Valid rights to work.
  • Proficient using software platforms for reporting to include the MS Office suite of products.
  • Tertiary qualification in engineering (electrical, electronic, mechanical, or mechatronic) or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Familiarity with the mining industry and mine-site operations.
  • Demonstrated experience in fault finding in electro-mechanical equipment.
  • Direct experience in one or more of the following areas: electrical wiring and safety, power distribution, mechanical maintenance, and repairs; basic electronics; metalworking; engineering drawing and design.

Who We Are (Our Values)

  • Safety is a Non-Negotiable - Safety isn’t just a value — it’s our way of life. It’s about creating a culture where physical and psychological safety are top priorities. We speak up, challenge assumptions, and hold ourselves accountable to protect one another.
  • One United Team – We thrive on trust, respect, and empathy. By embracing each other’s unique contributions and supporting one another, we build collective strength to solve problems, celebrate wins, and grow together.
  • Delighted Customers – Our customers, both internal and external, are at the heart of everything we do. By listening, understanding, and acting with care, we consistently go above and beyond to deliver exceptional experiences.
  • Always Improving – We are curious, courageous, and committed to progress. Every challenge is an opportunity to grow, and every step forward builds toward something extraordinary. Making or doing things better isn’t just a goal — it’s our mindset.

Revenue Operations Manager

The main mission of the Revenue Operations Manager is to implement programs (tools, processes, good practices, reporting, etc.) that increase sales performance and efficiency.

We look for someone who has the capacity to have a Strategic and tactical approach on RevOps, as well as being hands-on to implement autonomously tools, processes, and reports.

The RevOps team includes 3 teammates who will report to this position.

  • Responsible for the implementation, management, adoption of these tools

  • Collaborate with Data Ops to facilitate centralization and mapping of data, and to benefit from a global understand of our business journey.

Training and Performance Management

  • Onboard, train, and enable sales team members across geographies and disciplines
  • Assist the leaders of GTM teams to constantly monitor Revenue performance
  • Identify weaknesses and opportunities of our teams and systems
  • Work with Sales leadership to develop, execute, optimize and assess enablement program

Facilitation and process alignment

  • Conduct process mapping, analysis, and redesign to drive operational improvements
  • Assist sales leadership to set success playbooks
  • Serve as a liaison between Sales, Marketing, Growth, and Services teams
  • Maintain balance and drive of sales focus to address core strategic objectives while delivering to short-term revenue goals.

Goals

We expect a significant impact on:

  • Salesforce adoption from Sales (Good UX, good data)
  • Sales forecast accuracy (better pipeline management)
  • Increase in conversion rates
  • Reduction of sales cycle duration

Skills

  • Data-driven and analytical
  • Strong coaching and influencing skills
  • Great communication skills
  • Tech-savvy, resourceful
  • Natural problem solver
  • Project management skills

Swapcard’s Interview process

Our thorough interview process aims to identify exceptional talent to advance our mission while offering you a chance to explore your career potential at Swapcard.

1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.

2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.

3. Manager review with your future reporting manager

4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders

5. Reference check conducted by our people team

6. Offer

Values

Curious — We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.

Value-Driven — At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

Human — At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient — We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership — At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it’s about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

title: Tech Lead de Engenharia
description:

Para nosso time de Engenharia, buscamos pessoas talentosas e capazes de construir sistemas complexos e de alta qualidade.

Você estará diretamente em envolvimento com o negócio da empresa através da construção e manutenção de nossos sistemas.

Nossos principal pilar é a qualidade daquilo que entregamos, entendemos que o importante é fazer bem feito ao invés de fazer rápido. Focamos na simplicidade da solução, nas entregas em pequenas partes e na autonomia das pessoas desenvolvedoras, a partir de um trabalho colaborativo.

A maioria de nossas aplicações são construídas em Java, sendo necessário o interesse em atuar com essa tecnologia e na liderança técnica da equipe! Buscamos profissionais com habilidades de engenharia de software, gestão de pessoas e abertura para novos aprendizados!

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Orientar, motivar e desenvolver a equipe de engenheiros(as);

  • Definir e implementar novas funcionalidades;
  • Compreender e discutir os problemas e soluções propostas, buscando sempre a melhor solução técnica para os desafios encontrados;

  • Revisar o código entregue pela equipe, fornecendo feedbacks;
  • Orientar a equipe na divisão de grandes entregas em pequenas partes coesas;
  • Monitorar a solução implementada em produção, avaliando erros, performance e disponibilidade;
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado, identificar oportunidades de inovação e orientar a equipe na adoção de soluções que impulsionem o crescimento e a competitividade da empresa;
  • Colaborar com melhorias ou novos padrões na base de conhecimento da Engenharia.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Domínio de frameworks, bibliotecas e ferramentas, tais como Java, Python, JS, Ruby entre outros;
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura de Software, princípios e padrões de projetos;

Sobre a Empresa

O Asaas é uma super Fintech, Instituição de Pagamento credenciada pelo Banco Central do Brasil e tem como propósito maximizar a produtividade das empresas através da tecnologia. Oferecemos uma solução completa para gestão de cobranças, pagamentos, antecipações de recebíveis e atendemos mais de 200 mil clientes divididos entre profissionais autônomos, microempreendedores individuais (MEI) e grandes empresas.

Nosso sonho começou em 2010, em Joinville/SC e acreditamos que o céu não é o limite para o nosso crescimento. Não é à toa que atualmente nosso time está em vários cantos do Brasil! Mais de 800 pessoas sonham junto com o Asaas, de forma colaborativa, inovadora, eficiente, com autonomia e liberdade para voar alto.

Para saúde e bem-estar: temos assistência médica e odontológica sem coparticipação, seguro de vida, auxílio para compra de medicamentos e para realizar atividades físicas. Para alimentação e família: nosso benefício alimentação é flexível, por meio de um cartão de crédito, bandeira Visa. O saldo pode ser usado como cada um desejar. Na sede, temos free food e, para as famílias, oferecemos auxílio creche, programa de apoio parental e licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.

Para educação e crescimento: além de um ambiente de desafios e muito desenvolvimento, temos uma plataforma de treinamentos in company e disponibilizamos auxílio educação que subsidia 70% de mensalidades de graduações e idiomas, bem como a compra de cursos e livros, para que nosso time nunca pare de aprender.

title: Partner Development Specialist - Affiliate Marketing
description:
Who We Are

PartnerCentric is a leader in affiliate and partner marketing, leveraging innovative technology and personalized strategies to help brands grow revenue and drive unparalleled value. As a people-first company, we prioritize diversity in thought, experience, and background to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture. Our vision is to set the gold standard in partner marketing through proprietary technology and world-class client support.

We support remote work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

Position Overview

The Partner Development Specialist is an entry-level role supporting the growth and success of PartnerCentric\'s Partnership Development Center of Excellence. This role focuses on researching, recruiting, onboarding, and nurturing high-value affiliate and partnership opportunities to help drive performance and revenue growth for our clients.

This position is an excellent opportunity for someone with a sales hunter mindset—energized by outreach, motivated by goals, and excited to pursue new relationships. If you thrive on proactive communication, love the challenge of opening new doors, and enjoy laying the foundation for long-term success, this is the role for you.

As a key player within the Partnerships team, the Specialist will collaborate closely with senior team members and cross-functional departments to support the success of strategic partner relationships, manage administrative and reporting tasks, and contribute to PartnerCentric\'s reputation as a leader in the affiliate marketing space.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in digital marketing and partnerships with an added passion for sales development and partner acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Partner Recruitment & Support
    • Proactively identify and pursue prospective partners aligned with client goals, leveraging PartnerCentric\'s internal technology tools to support data-driven partner sourcing and prioritization.
    • Craft and send engaging outreach communications that reflect a sales-driven mindset.
    • Assist in the onboarding process for new partners, ensuring a smooth setup and integration experience.
    • Focus on activating newly onboarded partners and driving early-stage productivity within client programs to accelerate value generation.
    • Maintain detailed records of partner outreach, statuses, and relationship notes in internal systems.
    • Strategic growth mindset as it relates to scaling high-performing partners across other programs.
  2. Administrative and Relationship Support
    • Manage and update partner databases to ensure accurate tracking of communications, agreements, and performance.
    • Support the Partnerships team by scheduling meetings, preparing materials, and compiling reports that partners can access.
    • Assist in managing partner communications, such as newsletters, updates, and promotional opportunities.
  3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work with internal teams including Client Services, Marketing, and Technology to support partnership activation and education initiatives.
    • Help organize internal training sessions and contribute to the creation of partner resource materials and case studies.
    • Research AI tools to better support the team in the most efficient way.
  4. Performance Tracking & Reporting
    • Monitor new partner performance metrics and assist in compiling regular performance summaries and insights for internal use.
    • Use tracking platforms to pull data and provide basic analysis that supports decision-making and partner optimization.

A Week in the Life: Partner Development Specialist

  1. Monday: Join the weekly Partnerships team huddle; review and prioritize partner outreach and onboarding tasks.
  2. Tuesday: Research potential new partners for a client campaign and initiate strategic outreach with senior guidance.

Job description

Com 25 anos de experiência no mercado de Tecnologia da Informação, a MTP é uma empresa multinacional com mais de 1.000 colaboradores espalhados em mais de 11 unidades em nível global, o que nos permite promover o crescimento e intercâmbio profissional. Oferecendo um dos mais amplos portfólios, entregamos soluções inovadoras e flexíveis para ajudar empresas a resolver seus desafios mais complexos. Atuando em projetos em mais de 14 países , tais como: Alemanha, Reino Unido, Japão, Suécia, Coréia do Sul, Moçambique, Guatemala, Argentina, Chile, Peru, entre outros.

Main responsibilities

O Product Owner é responsável por maximizar o valor do produto resultante do trabalho da equipe de desenvolvimento.

Essa função envolve uma colaboração estreita com o Gerente de Produto, os Proprietários de Negócio e as equipes de desenvolvimento para traduzir a visão e a estratégia de alto nível do produto em histórias de usuário e tarefas acionáveis. O Product Owner garante que a equipe entenda os requisitos do produto e trabalhe para entregar incrementos de alta qualidade que atendam às necessidades do negócio.

TPOs são necessários (em vez de POs) onde os produtos são altamente técnicos e exigem "Facilitadores de Tecnologia" frequentes para impulsionar os recursos de negócios.

  • Possuir e gerenciar as histórias de usuário de sua equipe designada dentro do backlog do produto, garantindo que estejam atualizadas, priorizadas e alinhadas com o roteiro do produto e a direção estratégica definidos pelo Gerente de Produto.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário claras, concisas e acionáveis com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Refina e prioriza continuamente o backlog com base no feedback das partes interessadas, no valor do negócio e nas mudanças nos requisitos.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Gerente de Produto para entender a visão, a estratégia e os objetivos do produto.
  • Interagir com as equipes de Engenharia, Arquitetos e outras partes interessadas para coletar requisitos técnicos, feedback e validar histórias.
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as partes interessadas e a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir o alinhamento.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e liderança às equipes de engenharia, garantindo que as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas com os requisitos do produto e os objetivos do negócio.
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos de Soluções de Tecnologia e Engenheiros de Integração para projetar e implementar soluções tecnicamente viáveis.
  • Revisar e aprovar projetos técnicos, garantindo que atendam aos padrões de qualidade e estejam alinhados com a visão do produto.
  • Participar das reuniões de planejamento do sprint para ajudar a equipe a entender os requisitos e priorizar as tarefas.
  • Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha um entendimento claro das histórias de usuário e dos critérios de aceitação.
  • Fornecer feedback e esclarecimentos oportunos à equipe de desenvolvimento durante os sprints.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para entregar incrementos de produto de alta qualidade que atendam aos requisitos definidos.
  • Realizar revisões e demonstrações regulares do trabalho concluído para coletar feedback e garantir o alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Garantir que os recursos entregues atendam aos critérios de aceitação e estejam prontos para lançamento.
  • Monitorar e avaliar o desempenho do produto usando métricas e KPIs e tomar decisões baseadas em dados para aprimorar o produto.
  • Participar de retrospectivas e outras atividades de melhoria contínua para aprimorar o desempenho da equipe e a qualidade do produto.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor, melhores práticas e tecnologias emergentes para embasar as decisões sobre o produto.

Documentação e Comunicação:

  • Criar e manter documentação abrangente para histórias de usuários, recursos e requisitos do produto.
  • Comunicar o progresso, os riscos e os problemas ao Gerente de Produto e outras partes interessadas.
  • Garantir que todas as informações relevantes sejam compartilhadas com a equipe de desenvolvimento em tempo hábil.

Interfaces e Colaboração:

  • Gerentes de Produto: Trabalham em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Produto para garantir que o backlog técnico do produto esteja alinhado com a visão geral do produto, estratégia e roteiro.
  • Equipes de Engenharia: Colaboram com as equipes de engenharia para garantir que as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas com os requisitos do produto e as metas de negócios, fornecendo liderança técnica durante todo o processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Proprietários de Negócios: Interagem com os Proprietários de Negócios para entender as prioridades do negócio, reunir requisitos técnicos e validar recursos técnicos.
  • Arquitetos de Soluções de Tecnologia e Engenheiros de Integração: Trabalham com as equipes técnicas para garantir que as soluções técnicas sejam viáveis, escaláveis e alinhadas com os padrões de arquitetura.
  • Partes Interessadas: Facilitam a comunicação entre as partes interessadas e as equipes técnicas para garantir o alinhamento e coletar feedback sobre o desenvolvimento técnico do produto.

title: Payment Operations Specialist - Brazil
description:
Hi! I’m Eana, Chief of Staff at WeTravel.

I lead a global team of specialists focused on building reliable, scalable, and compliant payment operations that support our mission of powering the world’s best group travel experiences.

Right now, I’m looking for a Payment Operations Specialist to join our fast-paced, remote-friendly team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the security and integrity of our payment flows , while supporting our users through complex processes like disputes, chargebacks, and fraud detection. This is a perfect role for someone who thrives in dynamic environments and loves solving operational puzzles with a user-first mindset.

If you’re someone who takes pride in precision, loves optimizing workflows, and is excited about working at the intersection of travel, payments, and fintech , I’d love to meet you!

How We Work

As a Payment Operations Specialist - Disputes, you will be at the forefront of managing and resolving disputes, ensuring a seamless process for our users. Your main focus will be on handling the submission of disputes, coordinating with relevant stakeholders, and overseeing the resolution process. This pivotal role involves close collaboration with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity of our payment processes while providing exceptional support to our users.

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

You should apply if you:

  • Ideally a Bachelor’s degree in banking, finance, accounting, or a related field
  • Strong experience in payment operations, including managing payments, refunds, wire transfers, and ledger management.
  • Familiarity with payment service providers such as Stripe, Adyen, and Mangopay
  • Knowledge of regulatory compliance related to payments, sanctions, and prohibited countries.
  • Expertise in using fraud detection tools and techniques to prevent fraudulent activity.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including monitoring and analyzing monthly refund rates and dispute ratios.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to resolve payment-related issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex payment-related issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bi-lingual proficiency in Spanish and English is preferred.

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Prefer working in highly structured roles with constant supervision.
  • Are uncomfortable with handling ambiguous or complex payment disputes.
  • Don’t have experience or interest in payment operations, fraud detection, or compliance.
  • Struggle to collaborate with cross-functional teams or external partners.

On a Weekly Basis You Will Find Yourself

Payment Screening: Help manage the screening process for incoming and outgoing payments to detect and prevent fraudulent or suspicious activities. Conduct thorough due diligence on high-value transactions to mitigate risks and maintain the integrity of our payment system.

Fraud Detection: Identify and report any fraudulent or suspicious activity related to incoming card and bank payments, taking necessary actions such as blocking fraudulent users and escalating issues to our risk and compliance teams.

Dispute Management: Provide comprehensive support and guidance to WeTravel users throughout the dispute submission process, ensuring a seamless and efficient resolution. Collaborate with internal and external teams to facilitate the dispute resolution process while adhering to industry regulations.

Dispute Reporting: Monitor chargeback and win rates closely, providing in-depth analyses and proactive recommendations to optimize dispute management strategies, ultimately enhancing efficiency and effectiveness in resolving disputes.

Ledger Management: Conduct regular checks on accounts, proactively identifying and addressing negative balances or delinquent accounts, and follow up diligently to ensure timely resolution.

Cross-functional Coordination: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to address customer inquiries, requests, or issues promptly and effectively.

Benefits:

  • Full-time - Fixed Term Contract (as International Contractor).
  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy — enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.
  • Amsterdam Program – visit us in Amsterdam (HQ) for 2-4 weeks every year, staying in one of our WeTravel apartments.
  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.
  • Annual team off-site (often somewhere sunny ).
  • Extensive paid family leave.
  • Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.
  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.
  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.
  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry!

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products and services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products and services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Customer-facing first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed through to completion.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets effectively and work on projects over sprints, detailing work in tools like Jira (agile methods and sprints).
  • Set and work toward your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, aligning them to team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Use of open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta; work with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries, time zones, and familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication across all media; clear, friendly, concise writing in tickets, email, Slack.

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting – TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching.

  • Self‑management, accurate project scoping, prioritization, and cross‑team collaboration.
  • Comfort dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all data.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with AWS (hands‑on experience).
  • Experience with GAM and command‑line interfaces for efficient work.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • Passion for progress; adaptable and resilient in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Builder's mindset; excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner; influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Remote work experience.

Benefits & Compensation

As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. We offer a competitive PTO package, shared equity, remote work flexibility (up to 180 days per year), and a best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.

title: Customer Success Account Manager
description:
Nosso time de Customer Success

A equipe de Customer Success é responsável pela atuação direta com os principais clientes da companhia, apoiando diversas marcas a levarem seus negócios ao próximo nível e impactando diretamente os principais KPIs da Nuvemshop. Esta posição faz parte da unidade de negócio Nuvem Next , focada em clientes estratégicos com alto volume de vendas e operações mais complexas , que demandam um acompanhamento consultivo e personalizado para garantir o máximo desempenho na plataforma. Para isso, é essencial compreender profundamente o modelo de negócio, os objetivos e os desafios de cada cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções que impulsionem crescimento, eficiência e resultados sustentáveis. O time atua como um parceiro estratégico, garantindo que cada cliente da Nuvem Next continue evoluindo e atingindo todo o seu potencial dentro do ecossistema Nuvemshop.

O tamanho do seu desafio

Você Terá Atuação Direta Com o Que Chamamos De Large Merchants, Que São Grandes e Complexos Negócios Que Exigem Um Acompanhamento Mais Próximo Para Que Os Clientes Consigam Atingir Os Objetivos Por Meio Da Nossa Tecnologia e Ecossistema De Parceiros. Suas Principais Atividades Envolvem

  • Cuidar de um grupo de clientes (carteira) que tem um volume relevante de vendas, muitos são marcas reconhecidas do mercado, para que possam conhecer tudo o que temos para ajudá-los a crescer e que possam resolver com você todos os problemas que surgirem. Dessa forma, podemos conseguir uma retenção de 100% deste segmento. Ter cada cliente como o seu próprio negócio;
  • Realizar contatos com os lojistas com base na priorização de cada um dos negócios, seguindo como orientação tamanho, complexidade do negócio e faturamento;
  • Identificar cenários através do relacionamento com o merchant para ajudar na priorização e indicação de ferramentas e melhorias para a operação, que visem aumentar as vendas e trazer maior satisfação;
  • Trabalhar de forma estratégica, analisando KPIs e interações do lojista com a plataforma, para identificar oportunidades e possíveis cenários de churn, trabalhando de forma pró ativa e não reativa;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outras áreas chaves para garantir a visão 360 do cliente em todas as estruturas da empresa. O papel terá interação com as áreas de Suporte, Produto, Sales e Marketing.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência com gestão de carteira de clientes em empresas de e-commerce ou empresas SaaS.
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos;
  • Vivência com cliente com alto faturamento
  • Experiência com Marketing Digital, Performance e e-commerce;
  • Domínio das ferramentas G-Suite (planilhas, apresentações, texto);
  • Comprometimento e proatividade para atingir as metas planejadas e para solucionar os problemas dos clientes;
  • Que seja uma pessoa Customer Centric, focada no relacionamento com os clientes e que confiem em você como parte do negócio deles;
  • Comunicação assertiva, para que possa transmitir ideias de forma clara e em diferentes meios de comunicação;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com cenários dinâmicos e situações adversas;

São diferenciais

  • Ter conhecimento de Google Analytics ou tools relacionadas a estatísticas de e-commerce;
  • Inglês intermediário.

Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o team de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.

O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
  • Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;
  • Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;
  • E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.

Política de Privacidade de Dados

A Nuvemshop está comprometida em proteger a privacidade e garantir a segurança dos dados pessoais das pessoas candidatas às vagas que ofertamos. Para dar seguimento com a sua candidatura, teremos acesso a alguns dados pessoais seus e gostaríamos de repassar algumas informações antes de você continuar. Utilizaremos tais dados para conduzir os processos que envolvem o recrutamento e a seleção. Além disso, cuidamos dos seus dados pessoais de forma muita séria e só os compartilhamos com quem realmente precisa. Por fim, somente iremos mantê-los em nosso sistema pelo tempo realmente necessário. Para saber mais sobre a forma pela qual tratamos seus dados, inclusive dos seus direitos previstos em lei, basta acessar a nossa Política de Privacidade.

A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros. Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. 44,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 45 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role

The Technical Support Engineer provides consistent, world-class security, network, and product support for Tenable products. Our support engineers possess excellent knowledge of security assessment, vulnerability management and compliance auditing capabilities along with the drive to rapidly learn the newest technologies. Impeccable communication skills (written and verbal) focused on sustaining market leading customer loyalty is a key requirement for this position. The Technical Support Engineer provides support for Tenable’s entire product suite; including Tenable.io, Nessus, Security Center, Log Correlation Engine, and Nessus Network Monitor.

Your Opportunity

  • You will provide assistance and support to tier 2 level customers who have the Premier Service Offering by diagnosing their issues and efficiently providing resources and knowledge to identify root cause issues and solutions according to issue priority.
  • You will mentor and advise support engineers in the diagnosis of complex customer issues with Tenable products as well as techniques and strategies to effectively diagnose and resolve such issues and maintain a productive workflow.
  • Help coordinate and manage communications for internal incidents and service degradations instances to internal partners and help provide feedback for external customers. You will also ensure key account team and management stakeholders are aware of the status of all the customer issues or incidents you are involved with to ensure the customer is receiving consistent messages from all their contacts.
  • You will drive critical customer support escalations in concert with the support owner of the case for complex technical product issues. You will interface with the original support engineer and the customer via telephone and/or electronic communications in the areas of system configurations/setup, complex 3rd party product and code integrations, product functionality, software defect fixes, and enhancements.
  • You will be a significant contributor and topic driver for the Tenable product suite in creating, reviewing, editing, and publishing knowledge base articles and trainings for use internally by Technical Support and externally by our customers. This includes improving knowledge accessibility and the ease of use of the knowledge base/trainings.
  • You will facilitate New Product Introductions by working with the SMEs, Technical Leads, R&D, and Product Management teams to ensure the new design functionality is known and documented, creating materials to facilitate knowledge transfer from product to the Technical Support team, and ensuring all necessary hardware and software is procured and available for use in various Technical Support labs throughout the world.
  • You will respond to requests for assistance by support engineers, sales engineers, customer success managers, and other partners in various channels, such as email, Slack messages, jira updates, Zoom session, etc, to share your knowledge and expertise as a Tenable leader.

What You'll Need

  • Fluency and ability to explain technical concepts in English and Portuguese
  • To succeed at this job, you must have an understanding of basic operations in Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems, core concepts of security and vulnerability management, networking (TCP/IP), and precepts of software support.
  • You must be passionate about problem solving and have a genuine interest in helping our customers and our partners succeed.
  • You must be an effective communicator both verbally and in writing to ensure knowledge/concepts/solutions/status updates are transferred effectively to coworkers, peers, management and customers.
  • You must be confident in R&D interactions with a firm grasp of the technology that will allow you to work efficiently and effectively with the R&D and Product Management teams to prioritize and resolve design related product issues.
  • It would be preferred if you have familiarity with common security/compliance/benchmark auditing standards (CERT,SCAP, DISA STIGs, CIS, HIPAA).
  • You must have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent experience.
  • We are looking for someone with:
    • 2+ Years experience at a Tier-1 technical support level supporting security/vulnerability solutions
    • 2+ Years Linux / Windows server administration/troubleshooting experience
    • 2+ Years log file/debug report/diagnostic file analysis experience
  • We would like someone to join our team who has:
    • Ability to write bash, powershell, or similar scripts to automate tasks and troubleshooting
    • Deep understanding of firewalls and packet level inspection / troubleshooting
    • Working knowledge of Regex
    • Working knowledge of SIEM Solutions, SQL, and Certificate Authority (CA) infrastructure
  • You should have a strong desire to learn new skills at an accelerated pace and the have ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • You must have occasional availability to work weekends and holidays.
